adversarial_audit.objection: The signed quotient counterexample can have extensive scalar nullity.
adversarial_audit.resolution: False for the full projective line family: two is the exact maximum at every depth.

adversarial_audit.objection: The theorem is only a K=3 enumeration.
adversarial_audit.resolution: Every three global evaluation vectors lie in a line or an embedded Fano plane, which globalizes the analytic contradiction.

adversarial_audit.objection: Vanishing exact null fraction proves a spectral edge.
adversarial_audit.resolution: It does not control near-zero eigenvalues or weighted PGM mass and therefore is not a condition-number theorem.

adversarial_audit.objection: The rich subfamily inherits the nullity-two bound.
adversarial_audit.resolution: Deleting non-rich lines creates isolated points and removes the embedded-Fano constraints used by the proof.

claim_gate.reason: Exact scalar kernels are rigid and negligible per channel, but near-kernel and matrix-valued weighted traffic remain open.

falsifiers_triggered: The adversarial scalar kernel cannot occupy a constant fraction of one full-line carrier channel.
Exact scalar singularity is too low-rank by itself to establish a macroscopic PGM obstruction.
The next obstruction must use near-zero spectral mass, omitted lines, nonuniform weights, or matrix-valued flat sections.

proof_obligations.resolution: The Fano sign contradiction proves the universal upper bound and the F_2^2 quotient attains it.
A single full-line scalar channel loses at most two of 2^K-1 point directions.
Rank rigidity does not exclude a growing collection of small positive eigenvalues.
Overlapping carrier sectors and nonuniform physical weights prevent multiplying the per-channel bound naively.
Orthogonal multiplicity transports can support higher-rank flat sections not covered by the scalar Fano argument.

summary: Proved that every positive-holonomy scalar signing of the full projective-Steiner frame has at most two exact null modes, with the quotient construction attaining the bound.

theorem_contract.fano_local_proof: Three independent kernel evaluations would span a Fano plane; its seven signed line equations force simultaneously cef=-abd and cef=abd.
theorem_contract.globalization: Any three binary labels are collinear or lie in a Fano subspace, so every three kernel evaluation vectors are real-dependent and the global evaluation rank is at most two.
theorem_contract.rank_mass_consequence: For one equal-weight scalar full-line frame, exact null rank fraction is at most 2/(2^K-1).
theorem_contract.sharp_nullity_bound: Every real signed point-line incidence matrix of PG(K-1,2) has left nullity at most two for K>=3.
theorem_contract.sharpness: The first-two-bit quotient construction has an exact rank-two kernel at every depth.
